verdict.rationale: Gitea's own site says users can 'extend Gitea's functionality with our API and webhooks, creating custom workflows,' a first-party claim of programmatic outbound webhooks. That is the only mention, so the depth of the capability is unproven. The Slack/Discord/MS Teams sync is chat-app integration and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented event types to subscribe to, webhook registration via UI/API, payload format and signing/secret verification, delivery/retry behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
